text.en:
Subsection (e) of section eighteen (a) of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and fifty-nine, as
amended by Act Numbered Three thousand and eighty-one, is hereby repealed.

The Secretary of Justice, upon recommendation of the Chief of the General Land Registration
Office, is pot hereby authorized to appoint the necessary number of temporary employees at salaries not to
exceed twelve hundred pesos per annum each, to assist the judges of Courts of First Instance designated to try
and decide registration and cadastral cases.
Preference in selection for appointment of this new personnel shall be given to law graduates and persons who
are rendering or have rendered service in the General Land Registration Office.

The sum of thirty-four thousand and five hundred pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds
in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purposes of this Act shall be disbursed as follows:
For salaries and traveling expenses of the present temporary employees for the months of October, November,
and December, nineteen hundred and twenty-seven
For salaries and traveling expenses of the employees appointed in accordance with this Act for the year
nineteen hundred and twenty-eight>
------------------
34,500.00

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1927.
